input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, messaging domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include ehcache, hello, logger. Core business data revolves around BlackListDao, User, UserDao. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to create and manage tasks, so that I can organize and track my work effectively.
As a User, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a User, I want to manage ehcache operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a User, I want to manage hello operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a User, I want to manage logger operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
